text: Mechanics is a fundamental discipline that studies the laws of mechanical motion of objects and their applications. It serves as the core theoretical foundation for physics, engineering, and numerous interdisciplinary fields. It explores fundamental questions such as "how does force change the motion state of an object" and "how does an object deform or break under the action of force". Its theoretical achievements are widely applied in aerospace, mechanical manufacturing, civil engineering, materials science, biomedical fields, etc., serving as a bridge connecting basic science and engineering practice.
